comments.author: shafyy
comments.why: Interview covering Musk's argument on autonomy safety and Autopilot engagement study.
comments.text: Watch Lex Fridman's interview with Musk ( [VIDEO] ), where they discuss exactly this topic. Basically, Musk's point is that if self-driving cars are statistically safer than humans, then allowing humans to drive will make cars less safe again. Furthermore (regarding some other children here), the study that Lex and his team has done show that drivers are not less engaged while Autopilot is on (as many critics say).
